app.name: PurePeople
app.description: The suite's contact book. Other apps feed it as you work — mail traffic, meetings, messages — and it merges everything into one record per person: names, addresses, organisation, role, phones, notes, tags. Explicit edits are locked; feeds only fill gaps.

tools.name: fn_directoryBriefing
tools.description: Compile a single-call executive briefing of the PurePeople directory and CRM pipeline: contact/org/list counts, full list roster, tracked customer status & due-date buckets (overdue, due today, upcoming, undated), top ranked contacts, top organisations with computed people counts, staleness metrics, and hygiene flags (duplicate clusters, unlinked org domains). Optionally filter to one list or search query.

query.description: Optional search substring to scope contacts, organisations, and customer follow-ups.

list.description: Optional list name or id to focus the briefing on one curated collection.

today.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD reference date for customer follow-up due buckets (defaults to local today).

topLimit.description: Maximum top contacts and top organisations to include (default 10, max 50).

staleDays.description: Days since lastSeenAt after which a contact counts as stale (default 180).

tools.name: fn_personRelationshipDossier
tools.description: Assemble a complete 360-degree dossier for one person in a single call: full sanitized contact record (including locked fields, sources, and retained alternatives), acquaintance level, list memberships, linked organisation & colleagues, CRM customer profile & due status, per-board event prep, 1- and 2-hop encounter network with introduction paths, and an optional profile-photo research brief.

idOrEmail.description: Contact id, any known email address, or exact unique full name.

networkDepth.description: 1 = direct encounter ties only; 2 (default) = include 2-hop introductions.

eventList.description: Optional event board list name or id to scope network connections (do not combine with eventQuery).

eventQuery.description: Optional event board search query to scope network connections (do not combine with eventList).

today.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD reference date for customer follow-up status.

includePhotoPlan.description: Optional profile-photo research mode to embed an identity-grounded photo research brief without extra tool calls.

tools.name: fn_orgAndEventBriefing
tools.description: Prepare a rich preparation briefing for either one organisation (pass org) or one event board (pass list or query — supply exactly one). In org mode, returns full org details, linked people with acquaintance/customer status, unlinked email-domain matches, and top external encounter ties. In event mode, returns starred targets, already-met people, known vs new breakdown, on-board ties, and warm introduction paths grounded in recorded encounters.

org.description: Organisation id, name, or alias for an organisation briefing (mutually exclusive with list and query).

list.description: List name or id for an event board briefing (mutually exclusive with org and query).

query.description: Search query (e.g. event name or tag) for an event board briefing (mutually exclusive with org and list).

today.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD reference date for customer due-date status.

maxPeople.description: Maximum people entries to return in detail (default 50, max 200).

tools.name: fn_duplicateAndHygieneAudit
tools.description: Audit PurePeople data quality in one read-only scan: detect probable duplicate contact clusters (by normalized full name, shared phone, shared profile URL, or same corporate domain + similar name) with recommended survivor IDs, find unlinked email-domain-to-organisation matches, list frequent contact org names lacking an organisation record, surface high-interaction contacts missing metadata, and flag overdue or undated customer follow-ups. Never modifies or merges records.

list.description: Optional list name or id to scope the audit.

query.description: Optional search substring to scope the audit.

today.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD reference date for customer follow-up checks.

maxItems.description: Maximum entries returned per hygiene section (default 25, max 100).

tools.name: fn_batchCurateDirectory
tools.description: Apply a coordinated curation batch in one atomic store update (with optional dryRun preview): upsert organisations, upsert contacts (locking curated fields and filing onto lists), add existing contacts to lists, create or update customer follow-up profiles, and set per-board event prep. Validation errors abort the whole batch with zero partial writes. Never deletes lists, removes list members, or merges contacts.

orgs.description: Organisations to create or update (same locked-field semantics as upsertOrg).

items.description: Org patch: required name; optional rename, industry, owner, status, city, country, notes, avatarUrl, aliases, phones, domains, tags, links.

contacts.description: Contacts to create or update (same locked-field semantics as upsertContact).

items.description: Contact patch: required email; optional name, org, title, phones, notes, tags, addEmails, avatarUrl, links, status, topics, channels, lists.

listAdditions.description: Batch list additions (creates a list if new; unknown addresses are reported, never invented).

customerUpdates.description: Customer profile creations or updates for existing contacts (mode defaults to "upsert").

eventPreps.description: Event board preparation updates (each entry must specify exactly one of list or query, plus contact and at least one of meet/note/metAt).

dryRun.description: When true, validates the entire batch and returns the planned receipt without mutating the store.

tools.name: listContacts
tools.description: Search/rank people, optionally within one list. Ranked by interaction weight then recency. Every result reports which lists exist, so you can offer them by name.

query.description: Substring to match against name, emails, org, title, tags. Empty for everyone.

list.description: Only people on this list (by list name or id). Omit for everyone. Unknown names are refused with the list of lists.

tools.name: getContact
tools.description: Read one person's full record — every known email address, organisation, role, phones, notes, tags, and the provenance of where the suite has seen them.

idOrEmail.description: The contact id or any of the person's email addresses.

tools.name: upsertContact
tools.description: Create a contact or set fields on an existing one (matched by any known email). Fields you set are LOCKED: automatic feeds from other apps fill gaps but never overwrite them. Use this to record organisation, role, phones, notes, tags, links (LinkedIn, homepage, social media), or extra addresses the user tells you about. During research or enrichment, populate a missing avatarUrl only after matching the person by name plus organisation, role, email domain, or an existing profile link. Pass lists to file the person onto a named list (creating it if new).

email.description: The person's (primary or any known) email address.

addEmails.description: Additional addresses that belong to the same person.

avatarUrl.description: Direct, publicly loadable profile-image URL (https or data:image), not a web page or search thumbnail. Prefer a verified Wikimedia Commons image or official bio/staff/personal page. Treat LinkedIn as identity evidence rather than a preferred image host. Confirm at least two identity facts for common names; leave empty rather than use an uncertain match.

links.description: Labeled web links, e.g. [{"label":"LinkedIn","url":"https://linkedin.com/in/…"},{"label":"Homepage","url":"https://…"}]. Replaces the whole list — read the contact first to extend it. http(s) URLs only; an empty label gets a sensible one from the host.

topics.description: Interests / content topics this person cares about.

lists.description: List NAMES this person belongs to; a list that does not exist yet is created. Adds to the lists given — it never removes them from others.

tools.name: mergeContacts
tools.description: Consolidate two existing people by stable ID. Keeps survivor identity and primary values, retaining differing details as alternatives. Saves the full survivor before deleting the absorbed record. Retrying the same IDs safely resumes an interrupted merge. Replies with the survivor's summary (id, name, emails, set fields, alternatives, lists, hasNotes) and absorbedId; call getContact for the full record.

survivorId.description: Stable ID of the person to keep.

absorbedId.description: Stable ID of the other person to absorb.

tools.name: discoverAppTools
tools.description: Discover PurePeople's extended specialist tools (17 tools across customers, enrichment, events, lists, network, orgs) and composite functions (5 workflows). Prefer calling exposed composite functions and core tools first; use discoverAppTools when an edge case needs a specialist tool, then call it via callExtendedReadTool (for read-only tools) or callExtendedTool (for mutating tools).

query.description: Optional keywords describing the capability you need (e.g. "customers", "enrichment", "events", "lists", "network").

category.description: Optional category filter (customers, enrichment, events, lists, network, orgs, or "all").

names.description: Optional exact tool names to fetch full JSON input schemas for.

includeFunctions.description: Include already-exposed composite functions and core tools in the listing (default false: searches extended tools first).

tools.name: callExtendedReadTool
tools.description: Call one of PurePeople's read-only extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: customers, enrichment, events, lists, network, orgs). Strictly refuses mutating, destructive, external, or release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a read-only extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

tools.name: callExtendedTool
tools.description: Call one of PurePeople's mutating extended specialist tools discovered via discoverAppTools (categories: customers, enrichment, events, lists, network, orgs). For destructive tools, set confirmDestructive: true after checking with the user. Strictly refuses read-only tools (use callExtendedReadTool), external tools, permanent-delete tools, and release tools.

tool.description: Exact name of a mutating extended tool from discoverAppTools.

arguments.description: Arguments object matching the tool’s inputSchema.

confirmDestructive.description: Required (true) when calling an extended tool marked risk: "destructive".
